invalid_request.message: Failed to install audio due: request body must be a JSON object
invalid_request.log: The /Download request did not contain a JSON object.

invalid_audio_request.message: Failed to install audio due: Link must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL and AudioName must be valid
invalid_audio_request.log: Link is absent or does not use HTTP/HTTPS, or AudioName is empty/contains a path.

file_too_large.message: File size too much for install
file_too_large.reason: The file exceeds Maximum audio size.
file_too_large.log: Content-Length or streamed byte count exceeded the configured maximum audio size.

unsupported_audio.reason: Only WAV, MP3 and OGG are accepted.
unsupported_audio.log: Downloaded bytes do not contain a recognized RIFF/WAVE, ID3/MP3 frame, or OggS signature.

download_timeout.message: Failed to install audio due: the website did not respond in time
download_timeout.log: Connection timeout is 5 seconds and download read timeout is 30 seconds.

download_http_rejected.log: HTTP request was rejected. The runtime substitutes {reason}; a CF-RAY header marks a Cloudflare block.

download_connection.message: Failed to install audio due: could not connect to the website
download_connection.reason: Network, DNS, TLS, or server availability issue.
download_connection.log: requests raised ConnectionError before a valid HTTP response was received.

download_response.message: Failed to install audio due: the website returned an invalid response
download_response.reason: Remote response could not be downloaded.
download_response.log: requests raised a RequestException that was not a timeout, HTTP rejection, or connection failure.

invalid_content_length.message: Failed to install audio due: the website sent an invalid Content-Length header
invalid_content_length.log: Content-Length could not be parsed as an integer.

save_audio.message: Failed to install audio due: the audio file could not be saved in the soundmodule folder
save_audio.log: Writing or caching the audio at C:/Matcha/workspace/soundmodule raised OSError.

convert_audio.message: Failed to install audio due: audio conversion to WAV failed
convert_audio.reason: The source could not be decoded as audio.
convert_audio.log: libsndfile failed while decoding the accepted WAV, MP3, or OGG source or encoding PCM WAV output.

audio_not_found.log: The requested Audioname was not found as C:/Matcha/workspace/soundmodule/<Audioname>.wav.

play_failed.reason: The audio backend could not play the file.
play_failed.log: Windows winsound failed while playing the WAV file.

delete_audio.reason: The WAV file could not be deleted.
delete_audio.log: Deleting C:/Matcha/workspace/soundmodule/<AudioName>.wav raised OSError. The cache entry is retained if deletion fails.
